title: My Daughter Forged My Signature And Sold My Ukulele Workshop For $500K. So I Voided The Sale
description: I drained my $110,000 401(k) to start a ukulele workshop with my daughter, only for her to forge a dissolution, sell the brand for $500K, and mail me a $3,000 'gratitude' check. I found the original notarized contract hidden inside a ukulele case, voided the entire sale, and now run 'Four Strings of Fraud Ukuleles' where she sands fretboards in a shirt reading 'Strumming Lies' and each instrument ships with a QR code to her perjury conviction. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #UkuleleJustice
thumb_text: SHE STOLE MY BRAND, NOW SHE WEARS STRUMMING LIES
pinned_comment: If your daughter forged your signature, sold your ukulele workshop for $500K, and mailed you a $3,000 'gratitude' check, would you have voided the sale and kept her sanding fretboards in a 'Strumming Lies' shirt? Share your story below.
